敖林用尽最后力气，嘶吼咆哮，声音嘶哑惨烈，带着无尽悲壮与期盼。
敖宫伫立血泊之中，看着半空之中燃道殉族、身躯崩碎的太上长老，双目泪流满面，心口剧痛到极致，身躯剧烈颤抖。
他知晓，太上长老燃尽数万载修为、舍弃仙王道果、以身殉战，只为给它换来一线生机！
这是龙族长辈，用性命为它铺就的生路！
残存的几位重伤龙族高手强忍悲痛，死死拉住失神的敖宫，陈凡分身也强行催动力量，裹挟敖宫身躯。
留存龙族火种，才有复仇翻盘之机！”
敖宫骤然回神，死死咬紧牙关，抹尽血泪，将这份血海深仇、殉道之痛深埋心底。
它深深凝望一眼半空惨烈殉身的敖林，重重叩首，随后转身决然飞驰！
残余所有龙族高手紧随其后，跟着敖宫朝着祖地最深处的龙皇秘境疾驰而去。
陈凡分身催动本源之力，全程护持众人，一路冲破层层封锁，极速遁入祖地禁地深处。
半空之上，敖林的身躯已然崩碎大半，四肢尽数湮灭，唯有残存的躯干依旧死死抵住两大神王攻势，残魂不灭、战意不消，死死牵制外敌！
最后一缕残响消散天地，敖林身躯彻底炸裂，漫天金色龙血洒落龙疆，仙王道果彻底燃尽，神魂尽数湮灭，万古长存，再无踪迹！
敖轩看到这壮烈的一幕，内心不但没有触动，反而越发的变本加厉。
两大神王挣脱牵制，望着众人遁逃的方向，震怒滔天：“追！
二人即刻破空追击，紧随敖宫一行人踪迹，闯入龙皇秘境禁地。
可待他们踏入秘境深处，眼前已然是一片隔绝天地的古老结界。
群山环绕、古阵蛰伏，万千古老龙纹密布虚空，层层叠叠的先帝道韵笼罩四方，壁垒厚重浩瀚、坚不可摧。
这是龙族传承的终极秘地大阵，蕴含仙帝本源规则，隔绝内外、封锁虚空、隐匿气息，防御力极强！

敖宫一行人已然尽数退入秘地之中，稳稳扎根大阵守护之内。
两大神王全力出手，圣光狂轰、道力猛击，疯狂冲击结界大阵，可阵法纹丝不动、壁垒稳固如山，所有攻势尽数消融殆尽，根本无法攻破分毫！
结界之内，敖宫伫立阵前，望着外界暴怒的两大神王，望着远方血染的龙庭，眼底布满血色与沉痛。
太上长老殉族、龙族权柄尽失、神族外敌入侵、父皇失踪……龙族此时面对的乃是前所未有的巨大浩劫！
敖宫深知仅凭自己的实力根本不足以应付，现在他唯一能够指望的就是陈凡的真身，赶来支援了。

The latest chapter of Crazy Immortal Released from Prison_Chapter 2235 Martyrdom of the Family Page 1_Crazy Immortal Released from Prison Zifeng_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 2235 Martyrdom of the Family (Page 1)
Ao Lin used his last strength to roar, his voice hoarse and tragic, filled with endless tragedy and expectation.
Ao Gong stood in a pool of blood, looking at the Supreme Elder who was martyred in the air and whose body collapsed. His eyes were filled with tears, his heart was in extreme pain, and his body was shaking violently.
He knew that the Supreme Elder had burned tens of thousands of years of cultivation, abandoned the Immortal King's Dao Fruit, and died in battle, just to give it a glimmer of hope!
This is the path paved for it by the elders of the Dragon Clan with their lives!
The few remaining seriously injured dragon masters endured their grief and held on to the absent-minded Ao Gong. Chen Fan's clone also forcibly mobilized his power to wrap up Ao Gong's body.
Only by retaining the fire of the Dragon Clan can we have a chance of revenge and comeback! "
Ao Gong suddenly came back to his senses, gritted his teeth, wiped away the blood and tears, and buried the pain of blood feud and martyrdom deep in his heart.
It stared deeply at Ao Lin who died tragically in mid-air, kowtowed heavily, then turned around and flew away resolutely!
All the remaining dragon masters followed closely behind, following Ao Gong and galloping towards the Dragon King's secret realm in the deepest part of the ancestral land.
Chen Fan's clone activated his original power to protect everyone throughout the process, breaking through layers of blockades and quickly escaping into the depths of the forbidden area of the ancestral land.
In mid-air, most of Aolin's body has been shattered, and all his limbs have been annihilated. Only the remaining torso is still resisting the offensive of the two god kings. His remaining soul and fighting spirit are still there, and he is trying to contain the foreign enemies!
The last reverberation disappeared from the sky and the earth, Aolin's body exploded completely, the golden dragon's blood spread all over the sky, the Immortal King Dao Fruit was completely burned out, all the souls were annihilated, and there was no trace left for eternity!
When Ao Xuan saw this heroic scene, not only was he not moved in his heart, but he became even more angry.
The two god kings broke free from the restraints, looked at the direction in which everyone was fleeing, and said with great fury, "Chase!
The two men immediately broke through the air and pursued, following the traces of Ao Gong and his party, they broke into the forbidden area of ​​the Dragon King's secret realm.
But when they stepped into the depths of the secret realm, they saw in front of them an ancient barrier that separated heaven and earth.
Surrounded by mountains, ancient formations are dormant, thousands of ancient dragon patterns are densely covered in the void, layers of the Taoist charms of the late emperors are covering all directions, and the barriers are thick, vast and indestructible.
This is the ultimate secret formation inherited by the dragon clan. It contains the original rules of the Immortal Emperor. It isolates the inside and outside, seals the void, hides the aura, and has extremely strong defense!
Ao Gong and his party have all retreated into the secret place, firmly rooted within the protection of the formation.
The two god kings used all their strength to blast the holy light, attack with Taoist power, and attack the barrier formation crazily. However, the formation did not move at all, the barrier was as solid as a mountain, and all the attacks were completely melted away, making it impossible to break through at all!
Within the barrier, Ao Gong stood in front of the formation, looking at the two furious god kings outside, and at the blood-stained Longting in the distance, his eyes full of blood and pain.
The Supreme Elder was martyred, the Dragon Clan lost all its authority, the God Clan was invaded by foreign enemies, and the father disappeared... The Dragon Clan was facing an unprecedented catastrophe at this time!
Ao Gong knew that his own strength alone was not enough to cope with it. Now the only thing he could count on was Chen Fan's true form, who came to support him.
